_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Jogatz al Golf (Jòc de cartas) - Jogador {player_id}.
Objectiu: Obténer lo puntatge total mai bas dins aquest torn unic. Se las colomnas partatjan la meteissa valor, son somadas coma 0.
Valors de las cartas: A=1, 2-10=valor facial, J/Q=10, K=0

Accions (utilizatz parentèsis exactes):
- '[draw]' - Tirar del talon
- '[take]' - Prendre del mont de descart
- '[swap X Y]' - Permutar la carta tirada amb la posicion X (reng) Y (colomna)
- '[discard]' - Descartar la carta tirada

board.drew:
Avètz tirat: {card}
Ara devètz [swap X Y] o [discard]
board.took:
Avètz pres: {card} del mont de descart
Devètz [swap X Y] amb (non pòtz descartar)

options.final_turns: Torns finals! Vòstras opcions: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Vos cal: [swap X Y] (podètz pas tirar de cartas d'una pila)

action_desc.swapped: Jogador {pid} a permutat {new} amb {old} a la posicion ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Lo pòrt es voide! La partida s'acaba immediatament.
message.knocked: Lo jogaire {pid} a tustat ! Cada autre jogaire a drech a un torn de mai.
message.final_round: Lo jogaire {pid} {reason}! Cada autre jogaire a una mança de mai.

invalid.wrong_action: Utilizatz exactament UNA accion entre parentèsis: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], o [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: La pila de rebuts es bufa!
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Podètz pas tirar una carta presa de la pila dels rebuts. La cal cambiar.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Avètz una carta tirada. Devètz [swap X Y] o [discard]
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Cal una carta tirada per escambiar.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Cal una carta tirada per la tirar.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Posicion fòra dels limits. Utilizatz reng 1-{max_row}, colomna 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Podètz pas botar amb una carta tirada. Acabatz vòstre torn en primièr.
invalid.already_knocked: Qualqu'un a ja batut aqueste torn.
